threads.body: `pytest.mark.vcr()` wraps the test in a cassette automatically (pytest-vcr). Because this test also uses `vcr.use_cassette(...)`, the marker will cause nested cassette usage (and always tries the default cassette name), which can raise errors or make playback use the wrong cassette. Drop the marker here and rely on the explicit `vcr.use_cassette(...)` like the other OpenAI tests in this file.
